steppingStones.alt: A path of flat stepping stones across a sunny lawn, an even strip of grass between each stone.

ripples.alt: Three sets of ripples on a still pond, each spreading apart from the others, a pink water lily at the edge.

deskByWindow.alt: A desk by a window with an open sketchbook, a small round clock and a cup of tea, green hills outside.

reservoirPath.alt: A walker on a footpath curving round a still reservoir, hills reflected in the water and a stone dam at the far end.

turningSky.alt: Clouds building over a sunny hillside with a lone tree, a dark band of rain coming in from one side.

dayPack.alt: A small day pack on a stone bench with a bottle, a folded jacket, a map, an apple and a first-aid pouch laid out beside it.

twoFills.alt: Two painted rectangles, ink blue and sage green, side by side with a narrow, even gap between them.
